mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past two months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) over the past two quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
